## Scope

A quality audit was undertaken for the first quarter of 2024. A sample of **502** graded sets was selected for review and read again by a second grader. The purpose of the review was to assess the consistency of grading decisions and identify any areas requiring follow-up. The audit considered the agreement between the original grading and the second grading. Individual results were retained for discussion and ongoing quality improvement.

## Result

Overall agreement was **68.7** per cent. This result provides an overview of consistency across the reviewed sample and will support further monitoring of grading quality. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed privately with each grader to support feedback, clarify any differences, and identify opportunities for improvement. Further action will be considered through the usual quality assurance process.
